title: The Bored boy in the back row
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：bored　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bored 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the researcher wrote of ① a bored boy in the back row in the paper, and everybody in the lab said at once that it was ② more bored than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the researcher, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the bored ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most bored boy in the back row anybody in the lab had ever seen, or so the paper for February 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too bored to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the bored ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a bored tone in her voice, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as bored as the tone in her voice they had once had in the old lab. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was bored or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was ⑦ something bored, and nothing besides. The student from the next lab called the whole plan ⑧ quite bored; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the paper kept the names of the bored ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, at once, she wrote of another bored boy in the back row in the same paper, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ more bored than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most bored tone in her voice in the whole lab, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the bored ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 厌倦（前置定语 a bored boy in the back row：1952 年研究员在研究报告里记下的那件厌倦的男孩）
B. adj. 厌倦／无趣（比较级 more bored than：文中两处，一处比后排的男孩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 厌倦／无趣（最高级 the most bored：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 厌倦（表语 too bored to do：母亲觉得它太厌倦，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 无趣（前置定语 a bored tone in her voice：叔叔把整件事称作一桩无趣的声调）
F. adj. 无趣（同级比较 as bored as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩她话里的声调相比）
G. adj. 无趣（后置定语 something bored：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 无趣（受程度副词修饰 quite bored：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a bored boy in the back row
the most bored boy in the back row anybody
a bored tone in her voice
The most bored tone in her voice in

answers.why: bored 意为“厌倦”，1952 年研究员在研究报告里记下的是“一件厌倦的男孩”，此处作前置定语 a bored boy in the back row。
bored 意为“厌倦”，此处用比较级 more bored than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
bored 意为“厌倦”，研究报告上 二月 那行字说它是实验室里最厌倦的一件，故用最高级 the most bored boy in the back row。
bored 意为“厌倦”，母亲认为这件东西“太厌倦了，谁也用不上”，too bored to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
bored 意为“无趣”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩无趣的声调”，此处作前置定语 a bored tone in her voice。
bored 意为“无趣”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩她话里的声调一样无趣”，同级比较用 as bored as。
bored 意为“无趣”，研究报告上那半行字要的是“无趣的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something bored。
bored 意为“无趣”，邻实验室来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当无趣”，quite 修饰原级 bored。
bored 意为“无趣”，1962 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要无趣”，故用比较级 more bored than。
bored 意为“无趣”，母亲 1964 年说的是“整个实验室里最无趣的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most bored tone in her voice。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，研究员在研究报告里记下了一件厌倦的男孩。（a bored boy in the back row）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更厌倦。（more bored than …）
母亲觉得它太厌倦，谁也用不上。（too bored to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩无趣的声调。（a bored tone in her voice）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩她话里的声调一样无趣。（as bored as …）
到了 1959 年，研究报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件无趣的东西。（something bored）
answers: In 1952 the researcher wrote of a bored boy in the back row in the paper.
Everybody said it was more bored than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too bored to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a bored tone in her voice.
He said nobody would call it as bored as the tone in her voice they had once had.
By 1959 the paper asked for nothing but something bored.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 bored 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the researcher wrote of a bored boy in the back row in the paper, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most bored boy in the back row in the lab, or so the paper says.
My mother thought it too bored to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a bored tone in her voice, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next lab called the plan quite bored, and everybody laughed.
The bored ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
